title: Umbra Station Chapter 1: Awakening
author: Sam Foxall
description:
The first chapter in a sci-fi horror story, set on an abandoned space station overrun by horrific mutants where you must try and escape using the scarce tools available to you.

As of Version 1.0, the audio of the Holodiscs have yet to be added but will be added in 1.1

WARNING: This is the author's very first attempt at a text adventure so try to excuse derivative content or lack of technical mastery.
